WITH race_stats AS (
  SELECT r.name, SUM(res.points) as total_points, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS FLOAT)) as avg_laps
  FROM results res
  JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_points) as avg_points
  FROM race_stats
),
kept_races AS (
  SELECT rs.total_points, rs.avg_laps, oa.avg_points
  FROM race_stats rs
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE rs.total_points > oa.avg_points
)
SELECT 
  SUM(total_points) as sum_kept_points,
  AVG(avg_laps) as avg_kept_avg_laps,
  AVG(total_points - avg_points) as avg_excess
FROM kept_races
